d: Kartik purnima aur shri guru nanak dev ji ke prakash parv ke pavan avsar par bihar vidhanasbha men vipaksh ke neta tejasvi yadav ne rajdhani patna sthit takht shri harimandir sahib gurudvare pahunchkar mattha teka. is dauran unhonne guru nanak dev ji ke updeshon ko yad karte hue samaj men prem, bhaeechara aur samanta banae rakhne ka sandesh diya.
